prompt: Who is the most recent recipient of a Nobel Prize in one of the sciences who held Asian citizenship at the time of the award?
answer: **Kenso Soai of Japan** is the most recent such recipient. He was awarded the **2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry**, jointly with Henri B. Kagan, “for the discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis.”
